name: coinbase-mcp-ghost
description: A local read-only MCP server that attaches (as a 'ghost') to an already-signed-in Coinbase Advanced Trade tab over the Chrome DevTools Protocol for market-data and portfolio reconnaissance. OBSERVE_ONLY by default — no trading, no API keys, no auth flow.
